# `theming`

Synthesising a theme from one brand colour, or measuring which foreground is readable on a background.

## Selection

- **Use when:** Synthesising a theme from one brand colour, or measuring which foreground is readable on a background.
- **Avoid when:** Users pick the theme at runtime, or the values are known and can simply be declared in CSS.
- **Consider instead:** `features/theme-tweaker`, `ui-provider`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { INK } from "themelia-ui/theming"
```

## Composition

This family has no component-family dependencies.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

## Public declarations

### `deriveThemeElevation`

Kind: callable.

The whole shadow ladder from one intensity: the default theme's geometry and
`--shadow-ink`, with every layer's ink scaled so 0.8 reproduces it exactly.

```text
({ intensity }: ThemeElevationRecipe) => ThemeOverrides
```

### `deriveThemePalette`

Kind: callable.

A coherent brand from one primary colour.

```text
({ primary, mode }: ThemePaletteRecipe) => ThemeOverrides
```

### `deriveThemeTypeScale`

Kind: callable.

```text
({ baseSize, ratio, }: ThemeTypeScaleRecipe) => ThemeOverrides
```

### `ForegroundChoice`

Kind: interface.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `color` | yes | `string` | The chosen foreground. |
| `ratio` | yes | `number` | WCAG contrast ratio against the background, 1–21. |
| `meetsAA` | yes | `boolean` | Whether the ratio clears WCAG AA for body text (4.5:1). Reported, not enforced. |
| `measured` | yes | `boolean` | `false` when the colour could not be parsed and `mode` decided instead. |

### `readableForeground`

Kind: callable.

The more readable of `candidates` on `background`, measured. Falls back to `mode` only
when the background cannot be parsed (a `var()`, a `color-mix()`).

```text
(background: string, mode?: ThemeModeLike, candidates?: readonly [string, string]) => ForegroundChoice
```

### `ThemeElevationRecipe`

Kind: interface.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `intensity` | yes | `number` | 0 is flat, 1 is pronounced; 0.8 reproduces the default theme. |

### `ThemeMode`

Kind: type.

The vocabulary theme synthesis works in. Part of the token contract, so build scripts
need not import a React feature; `features/theme-tweaker` re-exports them.

```text
"light" | "dark"
```

### `ThemeOverrides`

Kind: type.

A set of custom-property overrides, ready for a style attribute or a CSS string.

```text
Partial<Record<ThemeVariableName, string>>
```
